title: Pin the turn-checkpoint receipt's verification_evidence order as a host-protocol contract
outcome: Pin the turn-checkpoint receipt's verification_evidence order as a host-protocol contract
acceptance: A deterministic test proves TurnCheckpointReceipt.verification_evidence holds exactly one freshly minted id per verification_evidence input, in request input order, including duplicate-content inputs and an idempotent replay returning the same ordered ids
The host protocol documentation states this ordering guarantee as part of TermAl's contract
environment_evidence and execution_observations ordering is stated alongside it, or explicitly not guaranteed

completion.summary: Pinned checkpoint receipt verification/environment record ids to request input order with per-input minted ids, duplicate-content coverage and exact replay/no-append assertions; documented all three host receipt list ordering guarantees.
